title: CD IELTS Listening Test 28 — Listening Section 2

sections.title: Questions 11–16
sections.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.question: How did Tracy first get involved in Mahana Market?

options.text: She set up the website
She had a stall there
She made things to be sold there

questions.question: Tracy became the market manager when

options.text: the previous managers had an argument
the market was threatened with closure
the existing manager asked her to take the job

questions.question: What new focus did Tracy give the market?

options.text: locally produced crafts
fresh fruit and vegetables
a greater variety of products

questions.question: What does Tracy say about entertainment at the market?

options.text: Anyone is welcome to provide entertainment
Entertainers need to be able to do a variety of things
Some entertainers have gone on to become famous

questions.question: How did Tracy get the idea of setting up a second market?

options.text: from members of the public
from traders at Mahana Market
from the local authorities

questions.question: What happens at the Kids' Market?

options.text: Children make toys to be sold
Children sell their own possessions
Children raise money for the local school

questions.question: Which TWO things does Tracy find most difficult about her job?

options.text: ensuring regulations are followed
the amount of administration involved
dealing with conflict between stallholders
the early start and long hours
introducing changes to existing systems

questions.question: Which TWO things does Tracy find most difficult about her job?

options.text: ensuring regulations are followed
the amount of administration involved
dealing with conflict between stallholders
the early start and long hours
introducing changes to existing systems

questions.question: Which TWO pieces of advice does Tracy give people thinking of having a market stall?

options.text: Try to vary your stock regularly
Don't be discouraged if you don't sell much at first
Make sure you choose the right type of market
Offer goods at low prices for the first few weeks
Take care with the presentation of objects on the stall
